verdict_text: Source data supports a reconstruction, but additional assumptions and validation are required before implementation or regeneration.
source_files_inspected: git history through 7927779 and current preparation history

supports: smartphone data at 10 Hz with GPS at 1 Hz
vehicle fields including GPS velocity, wheel speeds, yaw rate, indicated vehicle speed, indicated longitudinal/lateral acceleration
original synchronized and unsynchronized data locations

speed_candidates: Wheel Speed Front Left/Right/Rear Left/Rear Right (rad/sec)

frame_investigation.mounting_evidence: published phone-holder setup and axis-alignment figures; no per-trip rotation matrix or mount-angle record
usable_sources_for_estimation: smartphone orientation fields as a candidate attitude signal
vehicle indicated longitudinal/lateral acceleration and yaw rate for label-independent axis correspondence
limitations: vehicle frame signs and exact phone-holder orientation are not encoded numerically
Variant A yaw/pitch/roll naming is not an XYZ physical-axis guarantee
vehicle acceleration reference itself has sensor/lever-arm/noise differences
a transform estimated from dynamic signals must be validated on held-out train/validation trips without speed labels
forbidden_shortcuts: do not assume processed accel_x/y/z are vehicle axes
do not invent a fixed permutation/sign matrix
do not fit transform using indicated speed or its derivative

synchronization_investigation.published_status: source folder is manually synchronized where possible; unsynchronized data also exists
synchronization_investigation.current_method: truncate to min(S,V) and pair by row index

clock_domains.smartphone: elapsed milliseconds plus absolute local datetime
clock_domains.vehicle: time since start of day seconds

synchronization_investigation.diagnosis: row pairing is not physically valid for every trip

evidence.well_behaved_examples: many Vw trips have matching ~0.1 s clocks and durations within ~0.1 s

synchronization_investigation.required_method: use source timestamps, split at timestamp resets, establish monotonic elapsed clocks, estimate only a constant offset or piecewise affine clock map per valid segment, then interpolate labels onto the phone clock; reject segments without identifiable overlap
synchronization_investigation.offset_estimation: not a single global offset; phone absolute datetime versus vehicle time-of-day has variable offsets and DST/time-zone ambiguity, so per-trip/segment estimation is required

label_investigation.meaning: vehicle ECU/CAN indicated speed; not independently certified ground truth
independent_candidates: four wheel-speed channels converted from rad/s using wheel parameters if available
smartphone GPS SPEED (Kmh), low-rate and noisy
label_investigation.selection_rule: retain Indicated Vehicle Speed as primary target only after time alignment; compare against vehicle GPS Velocity and wheel-speed-derived speed on train/validation; do not change labels silently
label_investigation.reference_status: independent vehicle reference fields exist, but their agreement and exact provenance must be quantified before declaring one ground truth

android_contract.status: mapping is correct; declaration order of gyro fields is misleading but array indices are explicit

replacement_preprocessing_design.inputs: raw S/V matched pair from synchronized source folder
replacement_preprocessing_design.frame: estimate per-trip rotation using gravity for Up plus label-independent correspondence between phone dynamic acceleration/gyro and vehicle longitudinal/lateral/yaw signals; record matrix, method, quality score, and sign convention
replacement_preprocessing_design.sync: timestamp-reset segmentation followed by per-segment clock alignment; no blind row truncation
replacement_preprocessing_design.gravity: retain gravity-inclusive forward/lateral/up accelerometer channels to match Android contract; use smartphone GRAVITY fields only for transform/bias diagnostics unless explicitly part of input contract
replacement_preprocessing_design.gyro: map physical vehicle angular axes into forward/left/up order; resolve Variant A semantics before use
replacement_preprocessing_design.resampling: construct a 10 Hz monotonic phone-time grid over verified overlap; interpolate continuous IMU and target only within valid source intervals; no extrapolation
replacement_preprocessing_design.label: Indicated Vehicle Speed (km/hr) / 3.6, with vehicle GPS velocity and wheel-speed references reported for QA
replacement_preprocessing_design.missing_samples: reject gaps/resets or split segments; never interpolate across discontinuities
replacement_preprocessing_design.windows: 50 samples, stride 1, only within verified segments
replacement_preprocessing_design.split: existing complete-trip train/validation/test manifest; test remains untouched
replacement_preprocessing_design.normalization: fit six-channel statistics on train trips only
replacement_preprocessing_design.leakage: transform and synchronization use no speed labels, future samples, validation statistics, or locked-test data; reference comparison is QA only

missing_information: authoritative definition and calibration provenance of each vehicle speed field
documented S/V clock offset and dropped-sample map for every pair
wheel radii/gear/odometry calibration if wheel speed is used as an independent reference
unambiguous physical meaning of Variant A gyro yaw/pitch/roll axes
recommendation: Do not regenerate yet. Implement a separate non-destructive source alignment/provenance prototype and validate its transform and clock map on train/validation only. Regeneration is justified only after those QA gates pass; Android and the locked test remain unchanged.
